title: Array statistics
prompt: Implement `static (int Max, int Min) Bounds(int[] values)` — the largest and smallest elements in one pass. Throw `ArgumentException` when the array is null or empty.

tests.name: normal
tests.hint: One pass can track both ends; a single element is both its own max and min.

tests.name: guards
tests.hint: No data — no answer. Both must throw, not return a sentinel.
